capabilities: Sync tagged tasks bidirectionally with a dedicated Microsoft To Do list
Map task fields (due/scheduled dates, priority, completion, in-progress) between Markdown and To Do
Carry indented notes and one level of sub-checkboxes into To Do body and steps
Capture new To Do tasks into vault notes and route sub-tags to dedicated lists
Attach obsidian:// deep links that open and highlight the task line from To Do
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide sync tool; it only syncs explicitly tagged task lines with Microsoft To Do and never touches untagged tasks or other To Do lists.
extras: Documentation is bilingual (Chinese and English). The README notes the plugin is pending inclusion in the official community plugin directory, so it may need manual installation from GitHub Releases meanwhile.
problem: Tasks written in Obsidian Markdown stay in the vault, so users who rely on Microsoft To Do for mobile reminders and check-off have no bridge between the two.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks to Microsoft Graph for your To Do account—sign-in, push, and pull.
so Obsidian Tasks can still parse metadata from the end of the line

summary: Two-way sync plugin that mirrors tagged Obsidian tasks to a dedicated Microsoft To Do list, with notes, subtasks, reminders, and deep links.
